items.text: Kolimokinai Daudi ebe, “Koany, ejios Ipilisitian kaKeila, enasetc lukopejalin.”
Kanuka nun kinit Daudi EJAKAIT ebe, “Alosi eoŋ aidany Ipilisitian lu?” Kotema EJAKAIT Daudi atiar, “Kolot, kodany Ipilisitian, kitajar Keila.”
Kotemasi ituŋa luka Daudi ŋes atiar, “Koany, kikuriakar isio kane koYuda: mere do kikuriakar isio noi adepar kiilot Keila aitiii ajoresio nuka Ipilisitian?”
Kosodi Daudi aiŋit bobo EJAKAIT, Koboŋok EJAKAIT ŋes ebe, “Konyou, kolot Keila; naarai eiaikini Ipilisitian akanikon.”
Kolot Daudi ka iketuŋa Keila, kitijioto Ipilisitian, konotut ibarenekee, koarata kes kearit kaloepol noi. Kitajar kwaŋin Daudi luiboienenete koKeila.
Kosodi kanen, naakeria Abiatar okoku loka Akimelek Keila mama ejai Daudi, abu koyana epod kakanike,
Kolimokinai Saul ebe abu Daudi Keila. Kotema Saul atiar, “Kejaiki Edeke ŋes akanika; naarai agolor, kanu alomaria ore loeiaas ikirigin ka atiketa.”
Koram Saul ituŋa kere alosit oiie, alosit Keila, alukun Daudi ka iketuŋa.
Kojen Daudi ebe edonitor Saul ŋes emod; kotema Abiatar esasedoti atiar, “Koyau epod ne.”
Kosodi Daudi atemar atiar, “Wu EJAKAIT, Edeke loka Isirael, apupu ekonibulesit ebe ekot Saul abunore Keila, amudiar ere kanukan.
Kejaikinete ituŋa luka Keila eoŋ akanike? Ebuni kereka Saul kwape apupunio ekonibulesit? Wu EJAKAIT, Edeke loka Isirael, kenainait, kolimok ekonibulesit.” Kotema EJAKAIT atiar, “Ebuni.”
Kosodi Daudi atemar atiar, “Kejaikinete kereka ituŋa luka Keila eoŋ akan naka Saul?” Kotema EJAKAIT atiar, “Kijaikinete,”
Kosodete Daudi ka iketuŋa luemwaasi kwape akwat akanykape anyoun koKeila, kolototo kirimoto. Kolimokinai Saul ebe aku Daudi koKeila; mam abu kolot.
Kiboikin Daudi amodiŋ abuai nuegogon, kosalak akwap nakiukon kamodiŋ naka Sip. Komoenenei Saul ŋes ninipaaran, konye mam Edeke abu kijaik ŋes akanike.
Koany Daudi cbe alom Saul amoot aijarake: ajai Daudi amodiŋ naka Sip amonieik,
Konyou Yonatan okoku loka Saul, kolot amonieik mama ejai Daudi, kitogogon akekan kotoma Edeke,
Kotema ŋes atiar, “Sirikikurianar: naarai mam akan naka Saul papaka kidumuni ijo; ido iraun ijo ekabaka loeyait Isirael, katupakini eoŋ jo kapolou; ido ejeŋi Saul papaka ŋun.”
Kitutukoto kesi iarei kakonyen nuka EJAKAIT: kiboikin Daudi amonieik, kolot Yonatan togoke,
Kosodete Isipin alosit Gibea mama ejai Saul ebe, “Mam kereka Daudi enopit kobukosi kabuai nuegogon kotoma amonieik, koukot loka Kakila, loejai ari naka eŋalakimak naka amodiŋ?
Aso do, kobia, wu ekabaka, kwape imielar ekonitau kere alosit: ka sio da, kijaikini ŋes akan naka ekabaka.”
Kotema Saul atiar, “Kisirereŋ EJAKAIT yes: naarai kitimoto eoŋ,
Kenainait, koloto, kitogogoŋoto, kojenut koanyut da aiboisike naejai akeiuke, ka yeneanyunit ŋes kaŋina: naarai kalimokinitai ebe epiriana ŋesi noi.
Aso do koanyut, kojenut aiboisio nueperununo ka nueŋopenena, kopotu bobo aitogogoŋ mama ajai, kiupari do kayes: kosodi kanen arai ejai toma akwap, amouni ŋes kolukumin kere luka Yuda.”
Konye ajaas Daudi ka iketuŋa amodiŋ naka Maon, kotoma Araba kari naka eŋalakimak naka amodiŋ.
Kolot Saul ka iketuŋa amoot ŋes, Kolimokinai Daudi: ŋes do abunio neejai atiiba, kiboikin amodiŋ naka Maon. Kepupu Saul ŋun, kotupa Daudi amodiŋ naka Maon,
Kolot Saul owai ediopet loka eronat, Daudi da ka iketuŋa owai ece: kisunya Daudi alosit naarai akuriana Saul; naarai apotu Saul ka iketuŋa kolukunito Daudi ka iketuŋa aikamun kes,
Konye kobu ekiyakia mama ejai Saul, kobala ebe, “Kisunyite abunore; naarai iioreete Ipilisitian akwap.”
Kwaŋin koboŋo Saul katupit Daudi, kolot aitiji Ipilisitian: kanuka nun apotu komaikis aibois nin Sela-Kamalekot.
Sela-Kamalekot Apolouke Emoru loka Atiak, arai Aiku.
Konyou Daudi kanen, kiboikin abuai nuagogoŋ nuka En-gedi.
